## Repairs verified

`render_directory_at` now applies closed renderers to project, prime/designated seat, role id/kind/holder mode, merged names, live-holder seat/instance/machine, legacy-prime seat and latest-output kind/subject/head/result/writer (`main.rs:3223-3367`). Empty instances remain absent from the display. Invalid values become fixed length labels.

The new machine renderer admits only 1-64 ASCII letters/digits or `._-`; whitespace, quotes, controls, Unicode separators and framing delimiters cannot pass (`core/src/render.rs:122-132`). The seven-character head slice is reached only after the existing 7-40 ASCII-hex grammar succeeds.

Legacy-prime release commands require both a canonical seat and an empty or name-grammar instance; otherwise JSON contains `command: null` (`directory.rs:431-452`). Generated command words still go through `picture::command`/`shell_word`. The CLI then shows fixed raw-key guidance rather than a fabricated command.

## Remaining presentation qualification

When the prime-role recommendation is shown, its `note` is built as `the project's prime is {seat}` without `render::seat`. Recommendation serialization preserves it and the CLI appends it unchanged. A malformed legacy project prime therefore remains literal prose there even though the same value is contained in the new headline/designated-seat rendering. Core recommendations can be shown with `--suggest`, or when a workstream need makes the recommendation visible.

This is a persisted-identity path, not merely arbitrary substitution of a forged CLI response: `project set --prime` checks registry existence without a canonical-seat check (`http/governance.rs:752-768`). Selecting an existing malformed legacy seat suffices; new seat mint-time grammar restrictions do not sanitize old rows. No hostile designation, delivery or model-obedience probe was executed.

This producer and CLI sink are unchanged from the previous head. They are a nonblocking residual in this delta verdict, not a new authority grant. The new full-rendered-string test sets `prompts: []`, so it does not cover this path. Render the prime when composing that note, and include a surfaced prime recommendation in the containment regression.

Other unchanged raw formatter inputs include the failed-parse timestamp fallback and producer-authored recommendation/action text. Their universal safety is not established by the new fixture. Memory freshness is a parsed date prefix; template drift requires a shipped template and parseable version before it is shown.

The API note correctly labels retained `--json` identities as raw and untrusted. JSON is model-facing data; JSON escaping is not instruction provenance, shell quoting or permission to paste/evaluate a raw identity. Keeping original keys for deliberate legacy operations is distinct from emitting them as authenticated prose.
